## Validation

- [ ] JSON follows existing dossier format; every FACT_FIELDS entry appears once.
- [ ] Facts and typed capabilities agree; unknown is distinct from unsupported.
- [ ] Negative claims have an explicit denial or a dated, sufficiently complete interface/contract basis; inferred negatives state their limits.
- [ ] Positive claims have source evidence; conditional support retains its qualifications.
- [ ] Material caveats appear in corresponding fact notes or pricing/performance conditions attached to the dossier, not only in research notes or audit reports.
- [ ] Prices retain published units, billing conditions, minimums and allowances.
- [ ] Claims link direct primary sources; performance claims are labeled as claims.
- [ ] Affected research tables/gaps agree with the dossier.
- [ ] Individual dossier and capability validation completed (including non-launch providers).
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes; generated research tables are committed.
- [ ] For artwork: prompt, references and preview metadata included; `npm run validate:art` passes.
